[[Deft]] was right -- Keria is one of the best supports in South Korea."[https://www.espn.com/esports/story/_/id/29916126/top-five-supports-league-legends-world-championship Top five supports league legends world championship] ''espn.com'' * His favorite music genre is Rap. * His favorite Kpop group is NewJeans. * His role models are [[Mata]] and [[CoreJJ]]. * With 462 assists, he is the player with the most assists in one LCK split, achieved during [[LCK 2022 Spring]]. ** [[Wolf (Lee Jae-wan)|Wolf]] previously was the player with the most assists in one LCK's split (445 assists in [[LCK 2015 Summer]]). * He is the first support to win LCK's Regular Season MVP award. * He is the first to play {{ci|Caitlyn}}, {{ci|Kalista}} and {{ci|Varus}} support in the LCK. * Reached 3000 assists in the LCK on March 11th, 2023. ** Was the 10th player to reach 3000 assists in the LCK after [[GorillA]], [[Wolf (Lee Jae-wan) | Wolf]], [[Score]], [[Faker]], [[TusiN]], [[Deft]], [[Peanut]], [[Lehends]], and [[Bdd]]. * Reached 4000 assists in the LCK on March 7th, 2024 ** Was the 5th player to reach 4000 assists in the LCK after [[GorillA]], [[Faker]], [[Lehends]] and [[Peanut]] * Reached 5000 assists in the LCK on May 8th, 2025 ** Was the 4th player to reach 5000 assists in the LCK after [[Faker]], [[Lehends]] and [[Peanut]] *Reached 6000 assists in the LCK on May 13th, 2026 ** Was the 3rd player to reach 6000 assists in the LCK after [[Faker]] and [[Lehends]] *Reached 500 kills in the LCK on August 9th, 2025 ** The first support to reach 500 kills in the LCK ** His 500th kill was on [[Nongshim RedForce]]'s mid laner [[Calix (Syun Hyun-bin)|Calix]] with {{ci|Alistar}} * Reached 300 wins in [[LCK]] on February 24, 2024, becoming the 15th player to do so. * Reached 400 wins in [[LCK]] on September 10, 2025, becoming the 11th player to do so. * Reached 500 games in the LCK on June 21, 2024, becoming the 16th player to do so. * Reached 600 games in the LCK on August 02, 2025, becoming the 13th player to do so. * Reached 1000 international assists during [[2024 Mid-Season Invitational|MSI 2024]] on May 15, 2024 in Lower Bracket Round 2 against [[Team Liquid]], becoming the 5th player to achieve this milestone after [[Ming (Shi Sen-Ming)|Ming]], Faker, [[xiaohu]], and [[meiko]]. * Reached 100 international wins during [[2025 Mid-Season Invitational|MSI 2025]] on July 05, 2025 against [[CTBC Flying Oyster]] in Round 1, becoming the 4th player to achieve this milestone after [[Faker]], [[xiaohu]], and [[Caps]]. * Dubbed the "Legendary Genius Monster" due to his performance during the 2021 season. {{PlayerStatsTrivia}} === Individual Awards === * LCK MVP x2 (Spring 2022, Spring 2023) * LCK Player of the Split (Spring 2023) * LCK Supporter of the Year x5 (2021, 2022, 2023, 2024, 2025) * LCK 1st All-Pro Team x6 (Spring 2020, Spring 2021, Summer 2021, Spring 2022, Spring 2023, Spring 2024) * LCK 2nd All-Pro Team x3 (Summer 2020, Summer 2022, LCK 2025) * LCK 3rd All-Pro Team x1 (Summer 2024) * LCK Young Player Award – (Spring 2020) == Tournament Results == {{PlayerResults|show=overviewpage}} {{PlayerShowmatchResults|show=overviewpage}}
